thread:
Anya (PM): kicking off a rollout plan sync. goal: roll tenant-priority routing with A/B evaluation that measures latency, error-rate, and quality (rerank accuracy). need clear gates for customer opt-ins and a fast surgical re-enable path. any constraints?
Diego (Data): for A/B we should define primary metric and MDE. propose primary = rerank_precision@10, secondary = p95 latency. want MDE=3% absolute with 80% power. that drives sample size: ~60k requests per arm.
Priya (SRE): ops constraints: cannot accept more than +8% p95 latency for more than 10m in a region. if exceeded, auto-fallback for affected slice. also need token-cost budget alert (billing watchdog) to avoid runaway charges.
Ben (Backend): implementation note: we'll implement three flag levels: global toggle, tenant-level opt, and experiment assignment tag. sample flag yaml: ```
flags:
  tenant_priority:
    enabled: true
    experiment: "priority_ab_v1"
    tenants: { include: ["t-900","t-901"], exclude: ["t-777"] }
    fallback_variant: "baseline_v1"
```
Hannah (Sales): a bunch of enterprise customers asked for guaranteed performance. they want an "auto-optout" clause if SLA breach. can we promise automatic opt-out + postmortem within 48h?
legal-bot: flagged: any SLA language must pass legal review. required: opt-out process documented, data-sharing consent for A/B results.
Anya (PM): operationally we'll offer two paths for customers: 1) opt-out (no experiments) 2) opt-in (A/B) with opt-out-on-breach. need runbook for re-enable that requires on-call sign-off.
Priya (SRE): propose re-enable flow: create ticket -> on-call triages -> perform small staged re-enable (1 tenant at a time during priming window) -> monitor 30m -> full re-enable if stable. mark as `surgical_reenable` in incident.
Diego (Data): experiment run rules: minimum of 7 full days OR until required sample size reached. stop early only if safety gate triggers (latency or error thresholds). statistical checks: use sequential testing corrected for alpha-spend (Pocock), report one-sided p-value <= 0.025.
Ben (Backend): circuit-breaker design: per-tenant token budget + short-window concurrency cap + model-variant fallback. code snippet for quick toggle: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/flags/tenant_priority \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\
  -d '{"tenant":"t-900","enabled":false}'
```
Anya (PM): GA acceptance: 1) A/B shows no more than 0.5% increase in errors and MDE met for rerank precision, 2) autopilot fallback wired and tested, 3) legal signoff on SLA language, 4) customer-facing docs + opt-in form live, 5) runbook and re-enable playbook exercised in staging.
Hannah (Sales): also add a customer comms template and an internal "we asked you to opt-in" checklist. I'll draft and loop legal.
Priya (SRE): monitoring dashboards: per-tenant: p50/p95 latency, error %, tokens/sec, model-variant, fallback-trigger counts. add a red big-button kill-switch that flips the global flag and notifies #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "priority-rollout-heartbeat" posts progress every 15m during rollout windows, triggers incident on safety gate breach.
Diego (Data): add experiment SQL snippet for metric collection: ```sql
SELECT variant, count(*) as n, avg(rerank_precision) as mean_prec, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by latency) as p95_latency
FROM events.experiment_payload
WHERE experiment = 'priority_ab_v1' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY variant;
```
Anya (PM): action items: Ben -> flags + toggle API tests (today), Priya -> circuit-breaker + kill-switch (EOD), Diego -> sampling plan + dashboard queries (tomorrow), Hannah -> customer comms + opt-in list (EOD), legal-bot -> SLA draft review (72h). target: start A/B cohort next friday during prime window.
Ben (Backend): i'll include a cost-safety hook that pauses experiment if projected extra token cost > $5k/day for account group.
Priya (SRE): one more: add a canary warm window (02:00-06:00 UTC) per region for priming transformer caches. annotate rollout schedule with warm windows.
Anya (PM): thanks team. posting shiproom invite. if anything urgent ping me directly. :rocket:
